name: cklph-audit
description: Comprehensive, adversarially-verified, agentic whole-repo security suite. Twelve lenses (security, correctness, architecture, sca, iac, container, k8s, supply-chain, compliance, concurrency, state-machine, economic) × opt-in docs-drift + omission. Phases: Discover → Recon → Map → Review → Verify → DAST (opt-in) → Reconcile → Variant → Patch (opt-in) → Synthesize → SelfReview. Deterministic-tool recall (Semgrep, Trivy, Grype, Syft, Checkov, Kubescape, gitleaks) → LLM judgment → adversarial verify (evidence-arbitrated, reachability traces) → optional exploit-to-confirm in sandbox (CodeMender core) → optional patch generation + validation (test + re-exploit + LLM-judge) → adversarial self-review of the report. SOC 2 + CASA compliance matrix. Feed freshness checks. Optional MCP vulnerability intelligence enrichment (cve-mcp + vuln-intel-ext) for SCA lens. Read-only by default; DAST/Exploit/Patch are opt-in and sandboxed.
